title: Expression of Concern: TaVRT-1, a Putative Transcription Factor Associated with Vegetative to Reproductive Transition in Cereals
content: This is an expression of concern regarding: Jean Danyluk, Ndjido A. Kane, Ghislain Breton, Allen E. Limin, D. Brian Fowler, Fathey Sarhan, TaVRT-1, a Putative Transcription Factor Associated with Vegetative to Reproductive Transition in Cereals, Plant Physiology, Volume 132, Issue 4, August 2003, Pages 1849-1860, https://doi.org/10.1104/pp.103.023523.
